scope: Button grids, a picture button, a spinner, a configured picture popup menu and a splitter in an area-owned form: roles, labels, cell order and layout, stable paths, presses through each control's own On Clicked, a picture popup cell chosen from the plugin's menu through 4D's palette, VoiceOver navigation and activation

environment.compiler: 4D Server 20.8 Compile project, arm64_macOS_lib and x86_64_generic

pixels: Each AX run compares the form, before any action, with the same window built without plugin, component or helpers: zero changed pixels below the title bar, excluding the continuously animated spinner.
